thread:
maria: Heads up — p99 on /v1/embeddings.playground jumped in eu-central but p50/p95 look fine. dashboard shows single number.
derek: Which rollup key are you using? sometimes we accidentally aggregate by route but not by origin causing weird tails.
maria: widget query: `env=prod route=playground metric=latency_ms rollup=route_rollup`
anya: rollup=route_rollup collapses sample_origin. If some requests hit slow exit-nodes you get a shifted p99 even if p50 unchanged. That's expected but not ideal for a single-number widget.
observability-bot: Deployment notification: rollout playground-fanout increased 60% -> 85% at 1756667800
derek: timeline aligns. We should surface a provenance breakdown. Minimal change: show p50/p95/p99 columns per `sample_origin` along with the blended value labeled as "mixed".
maria: agree. For now i'll pin a narrow canary pinned to `exit_node=single-de` and post numbers.
anya: also confirm whether the widget uses `client_latency_ms` (includes gateway wait) vs `service_latency_ms` (post-routing). Mixing these produces inconsistent percentiles.
derek: good call. I'll add a quick lint to Console queries to warn when a percentile query includes ambiguous latency metrics or collapsed origin tags.
maria: canary results: single-de p99=210ms vs fanout p99=560ms. rolling canary back to 40% and opening a ticket to add provenance table.
deploy-bot: Rollout adjusted by @derek at 1756667885 -> playground-fanout 85% -> 40%
anya: adding runbook note: "Dashboard percentiles must state sample provenance; avoid single-number p99 when origins mixed."
derek: will follow up with a small UX patch: toggle to show per-origin percentiles by default when origin tags exist.
maria: thanks — filing the ops ticket and linking to the dashboard GH issue. :thumbsup:
